evals.prompt: ok the research/ submodule is brand new, i just ran git submodule update --init research and now there's no .obsidian/ in there. can you set it up the way risoluto expects? templates, dataview views, the pinned plugin set, all of it
evals.expected_output: Runs `node skills/risoluto-vault/scripts/apply.mjs` (or dry-run first), all files land under research/.obsidian/, research/templates/, research/views/. Reports the 3 PLUGIN-MISSING warnings for web-clipper, dataview, templater since they need manual install.

evals.prompt: something edited my research/.obsidian/app.json — i think a plugin overwrote useMarkdownLinks back to false. can you check the vault config and fix any drift?
evals.expected_output: Runs the applier, identifies the drifted file as REPAIR, restores canonical bytes, leaves operator-owned files alone.

evals.prompt: i need to bump the source.md template to add a `paywall: bool` field. how should i do that so it stays in sync everywhere?
evals.expected_output: Edits skills/risoluto-vault/assets/templates/source.md, points out that the matching `source.schema.json` may also need a new field, then re-runs the applier to push the change into research/templates/source.md.

evals.prompt: the vault thinks my research/ is dirty when i try to apply. i edited templates/idea-readme.md by hand because i wanted a different placeholder. what's the right move?
evals.expected_output: Explains that research/templates/* is canonical (operator edits live in the skill's assets, not the deployed copy), tells the operator to move the change upstream into skills/risoluto-vault/assets/templates/idea-readme.md, then re-run the applier.

evals.prompt: can you scope my research folder as an obsidian vault?
evals.expected_output: Triggers risoluto-vault, runs the applier with a dry-run preview, then applies.
